reference_sql:
WITH campaign_clicks AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, clicks,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY clicks DESC) AS clicks_rank
  FROM campaign_clicks
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, clicks, clicks_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE clicks_rank <= 2
alternatives:
WITH campaign_clicks AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT cc.channel_id, cc.campaign_id, cc.clicks,
       1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_clicks cc2 WHERE cc2.channel_id = cc.channel_id AND cc2.clicks > cc.clicks) AS clicks_rank
FROM campaign_clicks cc
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_clicks cc2 WHERE cc2.channel_id = cc.channel_id AND cc2.clicks > cc.clicks) < 2

SELECT t.channel_id, t.campaign_id, t.clicks, t.clicks_rank
FROM (
  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel_id ORDER BY SUM(a.clicks) DESC) AS clicks_rank
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.campaign_id
) AS t
WHERE t.clicks_rank <= 2
